title: About Us
meta_title: About Ananya Tots | Our Vision, Mission & Philosophy
meta_description: Learning through wonder, play and purpose. Discover the Reggio Emilia, Montessori, Finnish, nature, Anji Play and IB PYP inspirations behind Ananya Tots.

data.body_text: Our motto is simple: learning through wonder, play and purpose. Ananya Tots is a play-based, experiential and child-centred preschool, partnering with families to build confidence, kindness and a lifelong love of learning.

image.alt: Smiling little girl looking up through a magnifying glass among leaves and flowers, with a note reading Curious, Confident, Kind, Creative
Collage of children exploring pine cones, finger painting a sun and showing painted hands, with a note reading Little explorers, big ideas

data.body_text:
At Ananya Tots, childhood is a journey of joyful discovery, not a race. Children learn best through active play, inquiry and real-world exploration, and every child arrives with their own ideas, interests and questions.

Connection comes before teaching. Learning happens naturally when children feel safe, seen, heard and loved. Our educators act as facilitators and co-learners, and families are valued as essential partners in growth.

Social-emotional well-being is our foundation, complemented by sustainability, cultural diversity and global citizenship.
data.text: “For a small child, there is no division between playing and learning.”

items.title: Our Mission
items.text: A play-based, experiential journey partnering with families to build confidence, kindness and a lifelong love of learning in a safe, inclusive space.

items.title: Our Vision
items.text: To be a leading early years learning community where curiosity inspires discovery, play fuels learning, and every child grows into a confident, creative, responsible and caring global citizen.

data.body_text: We blend six world-renowned educational philosophies to create a holistic learning environment.

items.title: Reggio Emilia
items.text: Sees children as capable explorers, learning through art, music and beautiful learning spaces.

items.title: Maria Montessori
items.text: Fosters independence and self-care with hands-on materials, at each child’s own pace.

items.title: Finnish ECEC
items.text: Puts play, wellbeing and flexible routines first, without academic pressure.

image.alt: Two children painting together at a table full of colourful paint pots

items_2.title: Forest & Nature Pedagogy
items_2.text: Connects children to nature through outdoor exploration, gardening and weather play.

items_2.title: Anji Play
items_2.text: Encourages true child-led play and large-scale construction with minimal adult direction.

items_2.title: IB PYP
items_2.text: Uses inquiry and investigation so children ask questions, reflect and take action.

data.body_text:
Parents are a child’s first and most important teachers. At Ananya Tots, the child, parent and teacher form a connected triangle that nurtures the whole child.

When home and school share the same language of love, respect, care and encouragement, children feel secure to explore, make mistakes and become confident learners.

image.alt: A mother, her daughter and a teacher talking together, with illustrations of the child, parent and teacher connected

data.text: Connection comes before teaching. Learning happens naturally only when children feel safe, seen, heard and loved. With 30 years of experience in early years education, I have seen how trust, play and shared experiences build the relationships every child needs. We listen and observe before we guide, design every corner so children can choose and explore, and document learning to understand how each child thinks and where their curiosity will lead next.
data.affirmation: “I am heard. I am loved. I am trusted. I am capable. I am believed in.” Every child at Ananya Tots.

list_items_3: Nature & science: plants, animals, seasons and weather
People & our world: families, communities and cultures
Asking questions, predicting, trying things out
Caring for our world and using resources thoughtfully
Everyday life: how things work and why events happen

data.body_text: A play-based school does not mean an absent teacher. Our educators are thoughtful professionals who follow a cycle of care in every experience.

Learning areas are woven together through thematic and inquiry-based experiences, not taught as isolated subjects.

A single experience, such as exploring a garden, listening to a story, building with blocks or investigating water, brings together language, mathematics, science, physical development, creativity and social-emotional learning.

title: Careers
meta_title: Careers at Ananya Tots | Early Years Teaching Jobs in Ahmedabad
meta_description: Join Ananya Tots as an early years educator. Who we are looking for, our work culture, professional development, working Saturdays and how to apply.

data.body_text: Growing minds. Nurturing hearts. Inspiring possibilities. We are looking for educators who see teaching as much more than delivering lessons.

image.alt: Educator exploring pine cones and leaves with two children

data.text: Come grow with us.

data.body_text: At Ananya Tots, every child deserves the same care, respect, patience and understanding we would want for our own child. A teacher is a facilitator, observer, learner, creator and trusted adult in a child’s world.
We welcome educators who are:

items.item: Qualified in ECCE, B.Ed. or a relevant early childhood programme
Familiar with Montessori, Reggio Emilia, IB, Finnish or play-based learning (an added advantage)
Warm, patient, responsible and passionate about young children
A proactive learner committed to professional development
Creative with art, dance, music, movement, storytelling and play
Confident in planning, observing, documenting and meeting timelines
Strong in spoken and written English
Smartly presented and confident in your professional presence
Comfortable working from 8:00 am to 4:00 pm

data.body_text: A positive school begins with a healthy, respectful workplace. We do not encourage workplace politics, gossip or negativity. We invest our energy in children, learning, creativity and a happy school.
Our educators are encouraged to:

items.title: Professional Development
items.text: Take part actively in training and growth.

items.title: Reflect
items.text: Think about your own teaching practice.

items.title: Learn From Others
items.text: Colleagues and mentors share and support.

items.title: Explore New Ideas
items.text: New approaches in early childhood education.

items.title: Observe & Plan
items.text: Use what you notice to plan meaningful experiences.

items.title: Document
items.text: Share children’s learning journeys.

data.body_text: We value your time with family, and building community with children and families.

items.title: Working Saturdays & Events
items.text: Second Saturday is a working day, 8:00 am to 1:00 pm, for professional development. Teachers also join about 2–3 occasional Saturday events a year.

items.title: Holidays & Planned Breaks
items.text: Diwali Break, Christmas Break, Summer Vacation, National and Festival Holidays. The annual calendar is shared at the start of each academic year.

data.body_text: Fill in the vacancy form and the school will get in touch soon, or email your CV and a recent photograph to [hr@ananyatots.com, to be confirmed].

data.text: “As a mother never gives up on her child, a teacher never gives up on her students.”
data.text_2: At Ananya Tots, we don’t just hire teachers. We welcome educators who want to join a community that believes in children, in learning and in one another. Come grow with us. Come inspire young minds.
data.text_3: “The first five years have so much to do with how the next 80 turn out.” – Bill Gates
